title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES APPROVING THE MERGER OF THE LBP LEASING AND FINANCE CORPORATION (LLFC) AND UPB LEASING AND FINANCE CORPORATION (ULFC), WITH THE LLFC AS THE SURVIVING

text.en:
Merger of LLFC and ULFC. The merger of LLFC and ULFC, with
LLFC as the surviving entity, is hereby approved, subject to relevant laws, rules and
regulations.
LLFC and ULFC shall, in consultation with the CG, determine the mode of
the merger and implement the same with the approval of relevant regulatory
agencies. All assets and liabilities of ULFC shall be transferred to LLFC.

Compliance with Relevant Laws and Accounting and Auditing
Standards. The GCG, LLFC and ULFC shall ensure that the merger between LLFC
and ULFC complies with the following:
RA No. 11232 or the "Revised Corporation Code of the Philippines;"
RA No. 10667 or the "Philippine Competition Act;" and
Such other applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
In the implementation of the herein merger, LLFC and ULFC shall likewise
ensure compliance with applicable accounting and auditing standards, rules, and

Integration Plan. To effectively implement the merger and
carry-out the provisions of this Order, LiFC and ULFC shall prepare and implement
an integration plan, in accordance with existing laws, rules and regulations.

Reorganization and Absorption of Qualified Officers and
Employees. Within one (1) year from the effectivity of this Order, LLFC shall submit
its proposed reorganization plan to the GG, as approved by the LLFC Board of
Directors, subject to the principles and standards under RA No. 10149 and such other
applicable laws, rules and regulations.
In addition to retirement or separation benefits under existing laws and
regulations, the ULFC Board of Directors is hereby authorized to adopt a separation
incentive package for affected officers and personnel of ULFC, using as reference
the rates prescribed under EO No. 150 (s. 2021), and in accordance with other
applicable laws, rules and regulations.
Whenever applicable, affected officials and personnel of ULFC may be hired
by LLFC, subject to the possession cf the necessary service eligibility and other
requirements prescribed for the position.
2

Agency Support. All relevant departments, agencies, bureaus,
offices and instrumentalities shall provide full support and assistance to ensure the
effective implementation of this Order.

Separability. If any section or part of this Order is declared
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected
shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All orders, rules, regulations, and issuances or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 06
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Four.
By the President:
